messages:
Theo: Heads-up  I'm doing a targeted pass on samples that still say 'cache warming' and a handful that use `result` as the SDK var. Plan: replace with 'prefetch' and `response` respectively. Will open tiny PRs.

Alina: Good. Can you also check the microcopy around examples? We prefer imperative captions (e.g., 'Fetch an embedding' not 'How to fetch an embedding').

Theo: Yep. I'll convert captions to short imperatives and add a parenthetical under snippets: (note: `response` is the client param, not the API payload).

Priya: Please don't touch API schema names. Mike caught a rename attempt last week that confused integrations. Only change local variable names in snippets and UI copy.

Sara: I'll run the link-checker and MDX linter on the branches before you merge. There were three MDX playground failures tied to unescaped backticks in JS examples.

Theo: Thanks  I'll make sure all fenced blocks include language tags and escape backticks. Example short snippet for Python I'll use: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(response="Summarize the release notes", model_version="rwd-1.0")
print(resp)
```

Alina: Note: UI copy should be "model version" (two words), but code remains `model_version`. Also flag glossary change: change 'cache warming' pages to redirect to /glossary/prefetch.

docs-bot: Automated check: glossary redirects are allowed. Link-checker found 3 broken links under /docs/samples; I'll post report in #eng-docs.

Theo: Opening PRs now (py/js/go). Labels: `docs:migration`, `needs-glossary-review`, `needs-voice-approval`. Target review: 3 business days.

Priya: I'll take the Python PR. Sara can do JS. Alina will do voice check.

Alina: Will review voice this afternoon. If anything fuzzy, I'll comment rather than block.

Sara: Running linter now locally, will push fixes to the branches in a bit.

Theo: Thanks all  ping here when reviews are up.

Priya: ACK, thanks! :thumbsup:
